issue: Login status not persisted; newly registered credentials cannot log in
actual: Registering a new account (qatester2026@example.com) auto-logs the user in, but reloading the page (http://localhost:7019/) reverts to logged-out state (Login/Register links shown). Attempting to explicitly log in with the just-registered credentials returns 'Invalid credentials. Try: tech@example.com', proving the new account cannot actually be used to log in. Login itself works only with pre-seeded demo accounts (e.g. tech@example.com), and that session likewise does not survive a page reload.
evidence: Notification 'Account created! Welcome to ThreadHive!' then nav shows logged-in state; after browser_navigate reload nav reverts to Login/Register; login attempt with qatester2026@example.com shows error 'Invalid credentials. Try: tech@example.com'.

Edited Bio to 'QA-updated bio: automated testing enthusiast.' and Interests to 'Testing, Automation, QA', clicked Save; notification 'Profile updated!' appeared and profile page now displays updated bio paragraph and interest tags (Testing, Automation, QA).
Clicking 'Create Thread' with empty Category/Title/Content shows toast notification 'Please fill in all fields' and stays on /new-thread without creating a thread.

Selected category 'Technology', entered title 'QA Automated Test Thread - Rich Text Check' and body content, clicked Create Thread. Notification 'Thread created successfully!' shown and redirected to /thread/thread-1788376703407 displaying the new thread with correct title, category, author, and content.

actual: Thread content submitted with markdown syntax '**bold**', '[helpful link](https://example.com)' and a '- ' bulleted list rendered as raw literal text on the thread page ('This is a **bold** statement with a [helpful link](https://example.com) and a list: - Item one - Item two - Item three') instead of being rendered as bold text, a clickable hyperlink, and a bullet list. The content textbox is a plain textarea with no formatting toolbar (no bold/link/list buttons).

evidence: Typed a reply and clicked Post Reply; toast 'Reply posted!' appeared, reply count updated from 0 replies to 1 replies, and the reply text 'This is a QA test reply to verify FT-4 functionality.' immediately appeared in the Replies list with author and timestamp.

Filled reply textbox with 'Duplicate submission test reply - same content.' and fired 3 rapid synchronous clicks on Post Reply via JS. Despite 3 click events (and 3 'Reply posted!' toasts), only a single new reply with that content was added to the thread (Replies count went from 1 to 2, not 4), indicating duplicate identical-content submissions were not all persisted.
Clicked upvote button on the thread: count updated 0 → 1 immediately. Clicked upvote button on a reply: count updated 0 → 1 immediately. Both counters update in real time without page reload.

issue: No edit functionality exists for threads or replies
actual: On the thread page (as the author of both the thread and its replies), no Edit button/control is present anywhere on the thread article or on individual replies - only an upvote button is shown per post. Since posts/replies cannot be edited at all, there is no way to trigger or verify an 'Edited' mark or last-edit timestamp.

issue: Profile only shows thread history, no reply history
actual: Visited own profile (/profile/user-1) after posting 3 threads and 2 replies as TechExplorer. The page only displays a 'Threads by TechExplorer (3)' section listing threads created; there is no section, tab, or list showing the replies the user has posted (the 2 replies posted earlier in this session do not appear anywhere on the profile).

evidence: Clicking a poster's username link (e.g. TechExplorer) on a thread/reply navigates to /profile/user-1, which displays the poster's public profile: avatar, join date, reputation, bio, interests, and their thread history.

Searching 'mechanical keyboard' returned only the 'Building a mechanical keyboard from scratch' thread (title match). Searching 'Pomodoro' (a word only in the body content, not the title) correctly returned 'Share your favorite productivity tips!' thread, confirming search matches both title and body content.

Navigating to Gaming category (via sidebar link /category/gaming) displays a 'Gaming' header and only the single thread that belongs to Gaming ('Best indie games of 2023...'), correctly excluding threads from other categories.

Clicking 'Most Active' tab shows heading 'Most Active Discussions' with threads ordered by reply count descending: 89, 67, 45, 41, 38, 34, 31, 23 replies - correctly sorted by interaction/activity frequency.
Default 'Trending' view on homepage lists threads ordered by like count descending (156, 124, 92, 89, 78, 67, 56, 47), which is a popularity-sorted discussion list as required.

issue: No persistence of session or user data across reload/logout-login
actual: After logging in as tech@example.com, editing the profile bio/interests, creating a thread, posting replies, and applying upvotes, then navigating away and back (simulating logout/re-login via page reload), the session was lost (Login/Register shown instead of logged-in state) and all changes reverted: profile bio is back to the original 'Full-stack developer passionate about open source...' text, interests reset to original 'Programming, Open Source, AI/ML, DevOps', the new thread and its replies/upvotes no longer exist anywhere in the app, and 'Threads by TechExplorer' count dropped back from 3 to 2. None of the profile, posting history, or interaction state was restored.
